fact: On 19 December 2025 the SABS Board issued under the Standards Act 2008 draft South African National Standards on information technology, including SANS 8825-2 (ASN.1 Packed Encoding Rules), SANS 19785-1 (biometric exchange formats), SANS 22989 and SANS 42001 (artificial intelligence), for comment to 2026-02-18.
title: Standards Act, 2008: Standards matters (Notice 3708 of 2025)
publisher: Government Gazette No. 53873, Department of Trade, Industry and Competition
